summary: 本矩阵是概念方案的风险自评，不是主管部门、运营方或专业机构结论。完整风险登记为 risks 数组的 R-01—R-12 十二条（R-09—R-12 为 SEB v0.4 修订批次新增的生命周期风险）；dimensions 数组是其中前八条按官方八维口径的评分视图，两表以 risk_id 关联。分值只用于确定证据闸门和人工复核优先级。
summary_en: This matrix is the concept proposal's own risk self-assessment, not a conclusion by any authority, operator or professional body. The full register is the twelve entries R-01–R-12 of the risks array (R-09–R-12 added by the SEB v0.4 revision batch as lifecycle risks); the dimensions array is a scored view of the first eight under the official eight-dimension caliber, the two joined by risk_id. Scores serve only to set evidence gates and review priority.

dimensions.label: 数据隐私
dimensions.note: 成对任务测试可能涉及位置、交互、退出原因和合理便利记录，若范围失控会形成不必要的个人画像。
dimensions.note_en: Paired task testing may involve location, interaction, reasons for withdrawal, and reasonable-accommodation records; if scope is not controlled, this can build an unnecessary personal profile.
dimensions.mitigation: 默认不采身份、健康或障碍类别；任务编号化、最少留存、到期处置，并为每项额外数据单独取得可撤回同意。
dimensions.mitigation_en: Identity, health, and disability categories are not collected by default; tasks are numbered rather than identified, retention is minimised, disposal is time-bounded, and revocable consent is obtained separately for each additional item of data.
dimensions.human_review: 数据治理专业人员与参与者代表在 G0 审查协议，在 G3 复核实际留存和处置记录。
dimensions.human_review_en: Data-governance professionals and participant representatives review the protocol at G0 and recheck the actual retention and disposal record at G3.
dimensions.owner_role: 数据治理专业人员与参与者代表
dimensions.stop_condition: 数据用途、最少字段、访问范围、撤回或到期处置任一项无法解释和记录。
dimensions.stop_condition_en: Any one of data purpose, minimum fields, access scope, withdrawal, or time-bounded disposal cannot be explained and recorded.
dimensions.resume_condition: G0 批准协议，完成可撤回同意与处置演练，并由 G3 核验匿名化结果和实际处置记录。
dimensions.resume_condition_en: G0 approves the protocol, revocable consent and disposal are rehearsed, and G3 verifies the anonymisation outcome and the actual disposal record.

dimensions.label: 实施复杂度
dimensions.note: 连续路径、公共界面和人工接管跨越规划、交通、无障碍、运营与维护，多主体边界当前未确认。
dimensions.note_en: The continuous route, public interfaces, and human handover span planning, transport, accessibility, operations, and maintenance, and the boundaries between multiple responsible parties are not yet confirmed.
dimensions.mitigation: 首个 90 天只做可撤回原型，以 G0—G3 逐级验证范围、责任、测试证据和开放条件。
dimensions.mitigation_en: The first 90 days deliver only a reversible prototype, verifying scope, responsibility, test evidence, and opening conditions gate by gate from G0 through G3.
dimensions.human_review: 由未来授权主体确认 A 角色，专业团队和独立复核人分别承担 R 与 G3 审查。
dimensions.human_review_en: A future authorised entity confirms the Accountable role, with the professional team holding the Responsible role and an independent reviewer holding the G3 review.
dimensions.owner_role: 未来经授权的项目发起或运营主体
dimensions.owner_role_en: Future authorised project sponsor or operating entity
dimensions.stop_condition: 工作包没有可确认的 A 角色、专业 R 角色、依赖清单或下一步授权。
dimensions.stop_condition_en: A work package has no confirmable Accountable role, professional Responsible role, dependency list, or next-step authorisation.
dimensions.resume_condition: 形成书面 RACI、工作边界、依赖责任和闸门记录，且授权范围与可撤回条件一致。
dimensions.resume_condition_en: A written RACI, work boundary, dependency responsibility, and gate record are established, and the authorised scope is consistent with the reversible conditions.

dimensions.label: 公众接受度
dimensions.note: 传感、机器人、声音提示与活动可能被理解为监控、干扰或将基本服务强制数字化。
dimensions.note_en: Sensing, robots, audio prompts, and events may be understood as surveillance, disruption, or the forced digitisation of a basic service.
dimensions.mitigation: 公开系统状态、数据边界和退出方式，保留安静路线、人工服务、固定导视与无账户路径。
dimensions.mitigation_en: System state, data boundaries, and exit methods are disclosed, and a quiet route, staffed service, fixed signage, and an account-free path are retained.
dimensions.human_review: 自愿参与者顾问组审查任务脚本、现场说明、退出体验和匿名化结果。
dimensions.human_review_en: The voluntary participant advisory group reviews the task script, on-site explanation, exit experience, and anonymisation outcome.
dimensions.owner_role: 共同设计主持人和自愿参与者顾问组
dimensions.owner_role_en: Co-design facilitator and voluntary participant advisory group
dimensions.stop_condition: 持续异议未回应、退出困难、替代路径不可用，或现场提示让人误解为强制服务。
dimensions.stop_condition_en: Sustained objections go unanswered, withdrawal is difficult, the alternative route is unavailable, or on-site prompts are misread as a mandatory service.
dimensions.resume_condition: 共同设计修订完成，现场说明、退出和等价替代路径经参与者复核并保留公开变更回执。
dimensions.resume_condition_en: Co-design revision is complete, the on-site explanation, exit, and equivalent alternative route have been rechecked by participants, and a public change receipt is retained.

dimensions.label: 运维成本
dimensions.note: 多通道界面、人工接管、安静停靠和可移动构件需要持续清洁、维修、值守与故障演练。
dimensions.note_en: Multichannel interfaces, human handover, quiet docking, and movable components require ongoing cleaning, repair, staffing, and failure drills.
dimensions.mitigation: 每个原型同时交付维护卡、故障绕行和停止条件；未确认责任人及资源时不进入开放空间。
dimensions.mitigation_en: Each prototype ships with a maintenance card, failure bypass, and stop condition together; it does not enter open space until a responsible person and resources are confirmed.
dimensions.human_review: 维护人员在 G1 参与可达性与更换测试，运营专业人员在 G3 核对班次和响应链。
dimensions.human_review_en: Maintenance staff take part in accessibility and replacement testing at G1, and operations professionals check shift coverage and the response chain at G3.
dimensions.owner_role: 运营负责人和维护负责人
dimensions.stop_condition: 没有明确值守班次、备件、维护卡、故障绕行或人工接管资源。
dimensions.stop_condition_en: There is no defined staffing shift, spare parts, maintenance card, failure bypass, or human-handover resource.
dimensions.resume_condition: 责任人、班次、备件、维护与演练记录闭合，并由 G3 确认资源与开放范围匹配。
dimensions.resume_condition_en: The responsible person, shift, spare parts, and maintenance and drill records are closed out, and G3 confirms that resources match the opening scope.

dimensions.label: 政策不确定性
dimensions.note: 官方边界、文保、道路、市政、数据治理、活动与开放测试条件尚未形成可用依据。
dimensions.note_en: Official boundaries, heritage protection, roads, municipal systems, data governance, and the conditions for events and open testing have not yet formed a usable basis.
dimensions.mitigation: 相关内容持续标记为待补条件；资料和授权未闭合时暂停，不把概念图转写为审批、工程或政府承诺。
dimensions.mitigation_en: Related content is continuously marked as a pending condition; work pauses while material and authorisation remain open, and a concept diagram is never rewritten as an approval, an engineering conclusion, or a government commitment.
dimensions.human_review: 由具备对应责任的规划、工程、法律和数据专业人员在进入下一闸门前逐项复核。
dimensions.human_review_en: Planning, engineering, legal, and data professionals with the matching responsibility review each item before the next gate.
dimensions.owner_role: 规划、工程、法律与数据专业复核人员
dimensions.owner_role_en: Planning, engineering, legal, and data review professionals
dimensions.stop_condition: 适用许可、官方资料、专业责任或开放边界缺失，且现有证据不足以支持下一闸门。
dimensions.stop_condition_en: The applicable permit, official material, professional responsibility, or opening boundary is missing, and the existing evidence does not support the next gate.
dimensions.resume_condition: 取得与具体工作包相匹配的来源登记、专业复核或书面授权；不以无关材料替代。
dimensions.resume_condition_en: Source registration, professional review, or written authorisation matching the specific work package is obtained; unrelated material is never substituted.

dimensions.label: 空间争议
dimensions.note: 临时边界和概念中心线不能说明权属、道路红线、消防、防洪、文保或不同使用者的真实冲突。
dimensions.note_en: The provisional boundary and conceptual centreline cannot establish ownership, road redlines, fire access, flood control, heritage protection, or real conflicts between different users.
dimensions.mitigation: 只用公开背景解释关系；待官方资料和现场审计后，在可逆原型中测试通行、安静、停留和维护冲突。
dimensions.mitigation_en: Relationships are explained using public background material only; once official material and a field audit are available, conflicts over passage, quiet, dwelling, and maintenance are tested in a reversible prototype.
dimensions.human_review: 城市设计、交通、文保、消防及场地管理专业人员共同确认可试范围。
dimensions.human_review_en: Urban design, transport, heritage-protection, fire-safety, and site-management professionals jointly confirm the testable scope.
dimensions.owner_role: 城市设计、交通与场地管理专业人员
dimensions.owner_role_en: Urban design, transport, and site-management professionals
dimensions.stop_condition: OP 节点、路线或构件与真实通行、消防、防洪、文保、权属或维护需求发生未解冲突。
dimensions.stop_condition_en: An OP node, route, or component has an unresolved conflict with real passage, fire safety, flood control, heritage protection, ownership, or maintenance needs.
dimensions.resume_condition: 完成现场测绘、相关专业冲突审查和参与者复核，并把试验边界缩至可逆且已授权范围。
dimensions.resume_condition_en: Field survey, the relevant professional conflict review, and participant recheck are complete, and the trial boundary is narrowed to a reversible, authorised scope.

dimensions.label: 技术成熟度
dimensions.note: 跨模态导航、自动翻译和服务机器人可能出现误解、断网、漂移或不可预测行为。
dimensions.note_en: Cross-modal navigation, automated translation, and service robots may misread intent, lose connectivity, drift, or behave unpredictably.
dimensions.mitigation: 采用仿真、封闭、限定开放的顺序，始终保留固定信息、人工接管和 AI 关闭后的等价路径。
dimensions.mitigation_en: Testing follows a simulation, closed-test, then bounded-opening sequence, and a fixed-information channel, human handover, and an AI-off equivalent route are retained throughout.
dimensions.human_review: 技术、安全和无障碍人员在 G2 审查失败模式，独立团队在 G3 决定通过、有条件通过、退回整改或关闭 AI 层保留服务（四选一）。
dimensions.human_review_en: Technical, safety, and accessibility staff review failure modes at G2, and an independent team decides at G3 whether to correct, limit the pilot, or stop.
dimensions.owner_role: 技术安全、无障碍与服务运营专业人员
dimensions.stop_condition: 失败模式未记录，系统状态不可见，急停、固定信息、人工接管或 AI 关闭路径失效。
dimensions.stop_condition_en: A failure mode is unrecorded, system state is not visible, or the emergency stop, fixed-information channel, human handover, or AI-off path fails.
dimensions.resume_condition: 封闭成对测试覆盖失败模式，故障绕行和人工接管通过演练，G3 明确限定开放条件。
dimensions.resume_condition_en: Closed paired testing covers the failure modes, the failure bypass and human handover pass rehearsal, and G3 sets explicit bounded-opening conditions.

dimensions.label: 公平与包容性
dimensions.note: 六类画像只是需求框架，若招募单一、便利不足或只统计完成者，测试仍会掩盖排斥。
dimensions.note_en: The six personas are only a needs framework; if recruitment is narrow, accommodation is insufficient, or only completers are counted, testing can still conceal exclusion.
dimensions.mitigation: 协议报告参与结构、合理便利、撤回、技术故障和非完成原因，不用诊断标签或个人能力评分。
dimensions.mitigation_en: The protocol reports the participation structure, reasonable accommodation, withdrawals, technical failures, and reasons for non-completion, without diagnostic labels or individual capability scores.
dimensions.human_review: 参与者代表共同定义成功与退出，独立无障碍专业人员复核招募、便利和分母。
dimensions.human_review_en: Participant representatives jointly define success and exit, and an independent accessibility professional rechecks recruitment, accommodation, and the denominator.
dimensions.owner_role: 参与者代表、共同设计主持人和独立无障碍专业人员
dimensions.owner_role_en: Participant representatives, co-design facilitator, and independent accessibility professional
dimensions.stop_condition: 参与结构不足、合理便利缺失、撤回受阻，或分母删除非完成与技术故障。
dimensions.stop_condition_en: The participation structure is insufficient, reasonable accommodation is missing, withdrawal is obstructed, or the denominator strips out non-completions and technical failures.
dimensions.resume_condition: 补齐参与结构与合理便利，修正协议和分母，参与者代表与独立专业人员共同签署 G3 复核记录。
dimensions.resume_condition_en: The participation structure and reasonable accommodation are completed, the protocol and denominator are corrected, and participant representatives and the independent professional co-sign the G3 review record.

risks.pause_threshold_zh: OP 节点、路线或构件与真实通行、消防、防洪、文保、权属或维护需求发生未解冲突。
risks.pause_threshold_en: An OP node, route, or component has an unresolved conflict with real passage, fire safety, flood control, heritage protection, ownership, or maintenance needs.
risks.owner_role_zh: 城市设计、交通与场地管理专业人员
risks.owner_role_en: Urban design, transport, and site-management professionals
risks.current_control_zh: 只用公开背景解释关系；待官方资料和现场审计后，在可逆原型中测试通行、安静、停留和维护冲突。
risks.current_control_en: Relationships are explained using public background material only; once official material and a field audit are available, conflicts over passage, quiet, dwelling, and maintenance are tested in a reversible prototype.
risks.required_action_zh: 城市设计、交通、文保、消防及场地管理专业人员共同确认可试范围。
risks.required_action_en: Urban design, transport, heritage-protection, fire-safety, and site-management professionals jointly confirm the testable scope.
risks.resume_condition_zh: 完成现场测绘、相关专业冲突审查和参与者复核，并把试验边界缩至可逆且已授权范围。
risks.resume_condition_en: Field survey, the relevant professional conflict review, and participant recheck are complete, and the trial boundary is narrowed to a reversible, authorised scope.

risks.trigger_zh: 跨模态导航、自动翻译和服务机器人可能出现误解、断网、漂移或不可预测行为。
risks.trigger_en: Cross-modal navigation, automated translation, and service robots may misread intent, lose connectivity, drift, or behave unpredictably.
risks.pause_threshold_zh: 失败模式未记录，系统状态不可见，急停、固定信息、人工接管或 AI 关闭路径失效。
risks.pause_threshold_en: A failure mode is unrecorded, system state is not visible, or the emergency stop, fixed-information channel, human handover, or AI-off path fails.
risks.owner_role_zh: 技术安全、无障碍与服务运营专业人员
risks.current_control_zh: 采用仿真、封闭、限定开放的顺序，始终保留固定信息、人工接管和 AI 关闭后的等价路径。
risks.current_control_en: Testing follows a simulation, closed-test, then bounded-opening sequence, and a fixed-information channel, human handover, and an AI-off equivalent route are retained throughout.
risks.required_action_zh: 技术、安全和无障碍人员在 G2 审查失败模式，独立团队在 G3 决定通过、有条件通过、退回整改或关闭 AI 层保留服务（四选一）。
risks.required_action_en: Technical, safety, and accessibility staff review failure modes at G2, and an independent team decides at G3 whether to correct, limit the pilot, or stop.
risks.resume_condition_zh: 封闭成对测试覆盖失败模式，故障绕行和人工接管通过演练，G3 明确限定开放条件。
risks.resume_condition_en: Closed paired testing covers the failure modes, the failure bypass and human handover pass rehearsal, and G3 sets explicit bounded-opening conditions.

risks.trigger_zh: 六类画像只是需求框架，若招募单一、便利不足或只统计完成者，测试仍会掩盖排斥。
risks.trigger_en: The six personas are only a needs framework; if recruitment is narrow, accommodation is insufficient, or only completers are counted, testing can still conceal exclusion.
risks.pause_threshold_zh: 参与结构不足、合理便利缺失、撤回受阻，或分母删除非完成与技术故障。
risks.pause_threshold_en: The participation structure is insufficient, reasonable accommodation is missing, withdrawal is obstructed, or the denominator strips out non-completions and technical failures.
risks.owner_role_zh: 参与者代表、共同设计主持人和独立无障碍专业人员
risks.owner_role_en: Participant representatives, co-design facilitator, and independent accessibility professional
risks.current_control_zh: 协议报告参与结构、合理便利、撤回、技术故障和非完成原因，不用诊断标签或个人能力评分。
risks.current_control_en: The protocol reports the participation structure, reasonable accommodation, withdrawals, technical failures, and reasons for non-completion, without diagnostic labels or individual capability scores.
risks.required_action_zh: 参与者代表共同定义成功与退出，独立无障碍专业人员复核招募、便利和分母。
risks.required_action_en: Participant representatives jointly define success and exit, and an independent accessibility professional rechecks recruitment, accommodation, and the denominator.
risks.resume_condition_zh: 补齐参与结构与合理便利，修正协议和分母，参与者代表与独立专业人员共同签署 G3 复核记录。
risks.resume_condition_en: The participation structure and reasonable accommodation are completed, the protocol and denominator are corrected, and participant representatives and the independent professional co-sign the G3 review record.

risks.trigger_zh: 成对测试显示 AI 关闭态的完成率或体验反而优于开启态：AI 层不仅没有增量，还在制造负担。
risks.trigger_en: Paired testing shows completion or experience with AI off exceeding AI on: the AI layer adds no increment and is itself a burden.
risks.pause_threshold_zh: 任一场景×点位的成对读数中，关闭态在预注册口径下持续优于开启态。
risks.pause_threshold_en: In any scenario-node pair, the off state consistently outperforms the on state under the pre-registered definitions.
risks.owner_role_zh: 三方复核组（使用者代表、运营方、独立复核人）
risks.owner_role_en: The three-party review group (user representatives, operator, independent reviewer)
risks.current_control_zh: 基准 v0.4 的 G3 结论含第四选项「关闭 AI 层保留服务」，使该处置成为合法结论而非失败。
risks.current_control_en: The v0.4 G3 outcome set includes closing the AI layer while retaining the service, making this a legitimate outcome rather than a failure.
risks.required_action_zh: 触发后不得以加装更多 AI 作为回应；进入设计复核，AI 层的价值须重新举证，举证不成即执行 G3 第四结论。
risks.required_action_en: On trigger, adding more AI is not a response; a design review opens, the AI layer must re-prove its value, and failing that the fourth G3 outcome executes.
risks.resume_condition_zh: AI 层在同口径复测中重新证明增量，或按第四结论转入非 AI 常态服务。
risks.resume_condition_en: The AI layer re-proves its increment under the same definitions, or the service continues on non-AI channels under the fourth outcome.

risks.trigger_zh: 人工路径在价格、排队、时段或功能上被施加差别条件：能完成同一件事，但更贵、更慢、限时段或功能阉割。
risks.trigger_en: The manual path carries differential terms of price, queueing, hours or function: the same task completes, but dearer, slower, time-boxed or stripped down.
risks.pause_threshold_zh: 等价三维条件（时间比、附加成本、选择前可发现性）任一维在实测中不满足。
risks.pause_threshold_en: Any of the three equivalence conditions (time ratio, extra cost, pre-selection discoverability) fails in measurement.
risks.owner_role_en: The operator and the independent reviewer
risks.current_control_zh: 基准 v0.4 等价条件三维判据与 EQUIVALENCE_CONDITION_UNMET 违例码；阈值预注册不可回溯。
risks.current_control_en: The v0.4 three-dimension equivalence conditions with EQUIVALENCE_CONDITION_UNMET; thresholds pre-registered and non-retroactive.
risks.required_action_zh: 该人工路径从等价分子中剔除并登记差别条件；整改后按预注册口径复测。
risks.required_action_en: The path leaves the equivalence numerator, the differential term is registered, and re-measurement follows the pre-registered definitions after correction.
risks.resume_condition_zh: 三维条件全部满足的复测记录。
risks.resume_condition_en: A re-measurement record satisfying all three conditions.

risks.trigger_zh: L4b 节点的 review_due 已过而三方复核未发生：常态运行失去有效期背书。
risks.trigger_en: An L4b node passes its review_due with no three-party review: continuous operation loses its tenure endorsement.
risks.pause_threshold_zh: 运行声明的 as_of_date 晚于任一 L4b 节点的 review_due。
risks.pause_threshold_en: The run-declared as_of_date is later than any L4b node's review_due.
risks.owner_role_zh: 运营方（发起复审）与三方复核组（裁决续期）
risks.owner_role_en: The operator (convening) and the three-party group (ruling on renewal)
risks.current_control_zh: 基准 v0.4 REVIEW_OVERDUE 违例码：逾期即报有效等级 L0，回到资料与许可起点。
risks.current_control_en: The v0.4 REVIEW_OVERDUE code: overdue means an effective level of L0, back at the evidence-and-permission start line.
risks.required_action_zh: 立即按 L0 对待并召集复审；复审前不得以 L4b 名义申报覆盖。
risks.required_action_en: Treat as L0 at once and convene the review; no coverage may be claimed as L4b before it.
risks.resume_condition_zh: 三方复核签署续期并写入新的 review_due。
risks.resume_condition_en: A signed renewal with a new review_due.

risks.trigger_zh: AI 层退役、更换供应商或项目终止时，固定导视、人工求助点等非 AI 通道被一并撤除。
risks.trigger_en: When the AI layer is decommissioned, the vendor changes or the project ends, fixed signage, staffed help points and other non-AI channels are taken down with it.
risks.pause_threshold_zh: 任何退役方案含撤除非 AI 通道的条目，或 non_ai_channel_floor 任一项被改为可削减。
risks.pause_threshold_en: Any decommission plan lists removal of a non-AI channel, or any non_ai_channel_floor entry turns reducible.
risks.owner_role_en: The operator and the asset recipient
risks.current_control_zh: 基准 v0.4 decommission_path 三个取值均保全非 AI 通道；DECOMMISSION_TAKES_NON_AI_CHANNEL 与 NON_AI_FLOOR_REDUCED 违例码；residual_asset 登记留城资产。
risks.current_control_en: All three v0.4 decommission_path values preserve non-AI channels; the DECOMMISSION_TAKES_NON_AI_CHANNEL and NON_AI_FLOOR_REDUCED codes; residual_asset registers what stays.
risks.required_action_zh: 退役方案退回重编；撤除与验收的证据分离，非 AI 通道存续证据单独归档。
risks.required_action_en: The plan returns for redrafting; removal and acceptance evidence stay separate, with the channels' survival evidenced on its own file.
risks.resume_condition_zh: 修订后的退役方案经三方复核确认非 AI 通道完整存续。
risks.resume_condition_en: The revised plan confirmed by three-party review with the non-AI channels intact.
